card.title: A6M2-21 ZERO
card.text: The first card played by the enemy each turn costs double.
card.flavorText: The Japanese Zero, officially known as the Mitsubishi A6M Zero, was a legendary aircraft that played a pivotal role in the early years of WWII. Known for its exceptional agility and long-range capabilities, the Zero was the pride of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Air Service and became widely recognized as a symbol of Japan's air strength during the war. The Model 21 variant first flew in 1941 and was introduced with folding wingtips, which allowed it to fit on aircraft carriers, and a 520 liters wing tank plus a 320 liters drop tank which improved its range significantly. A total of 740 Model 21 variants were built throughout the war which made it one of the most produced versions. Two other versions of Model 21 were built in smaller numbers, the Nakajima-built A6M2-N "Rufe" floatplane, and the A6M2-K two-seat trainer.
